map.对比 S 型（穿越式）与 U 型（返回式）拣货路径的行走距离与耗时，帮助选择更优: Compare the walking distance and time of S-shaped (cross-over) and U-shaped (return) picking routes to help choose a better picking strategy.
map.S 型（穿越式）与 U 型（返回式）定量对比：S 型通道内行走距离=通道数×通道: Quantitative comparison of S-shaped (cross-over) and U-shaped (return) routes: in an S-shaped route the walking distance inside the aisles = aisle count x aisle length, in a U-shaped route = 2 x aisle count x aisle length (you enter an aisle and come back the same way); the lateral distance between aisles is identical in both, namely (aisle count - 1) x aisle spacing.
map.行走与拣货耗时拆分：行走耗时=总行走距离÷行走速度，拣货耗时=拣货点总数×单点拣: Walking and picking time split: walking time = total walking distance / walking speed, picking time = total pick points x per-point picking time (total pick points = aisle count x pick points per aisle); picking time is independent of the route, so the whole difference comes from walking distance.
map.方案落地与复核：工具取总耗时较小者作为推荐路径，节省百分比=两路径总耗时之差÷较: Implementation and review: the tool takes the shorter total time as the recommended route; savings percentage = (difference of the two totals) / the larger total x 100. After the output, manually review whether every aisle really must be entered and how evenly the pick points are distributed, and convert manually if only part of the aisles is walked.
map.算例：8 通道仓库的 S 型 vs U 型对比: Example: S-shaped vs U-shaped routes in an 8-aisle warehouse
map.：输入：通道数 8、通道长 20 m、通道间距 3 m、行走速度 1.2 m/s: Input: 8 aisles, aisle length 20 m, aisle spacing 3 m, walking speed 1.2 m/s, per-point picking time 10 s, 3 pick points per aisle. Total pick points = 8 x 3 = 24, picking time = 24 x 10 = 240 s. S-shaped: inside aisles 8 x 20 = 160 m, lateral (8 - 1) x 3 = 21 m, total 181.0 m, walking 150.83 s, total time 390.83 s (6 min 31 sec). U-shaped: inside aisles 8 x 20 x 2 = 320 m, lateral 21 m, total 341.0 m, walking 284.17 s, total time 524.17 s (8 min 44 sec). Conclusion: the S-shaped route is recommended, saving 133.33 s or 25.4%. With another set of parameters (4 aisles, 30 m long, 3 m spacing, 1.2 m/s, 15 s per point, 5 points per aisle) the S-shaped route takes 407.5 s and the U-shaped 507.5 s, saving 100.0 s (19.7%).
map.什么情况下 U 型反而更优？: When is the U-shaped route actually better?
map.当拣货点集中在少数通道、或通道很长而横向间距很小、且允许只进入需要拣货的通道时，: When the pick points concentrate in a few aisles, or the aisles are long with small lateral spacing, and it is allowed to enter only the aisles that need picking, the U-shaped route can skip irrelevant aisles and end up shorter. But this tool models the case where every aisle must be entered and traversed, in which the U-shaped distance is always twice the S-shaped in-aisle distance, so the S-shaped route always wins in this model; if the real operation only covers part of the aisles, convert manually using the actual number of aisles.
map.为什么两条路径的拣货耗时是一样的？: Why is the picking time the same for both routes?
map.拣货点总数由通道数与每通道拣货点决定，单点拣货时间也是固定输入，都不随路径策略变: The total number of pick points is set by the aisle count and the pick points per aisle, and the per-point picking time is also a fixed input, so neither varies with the route strategy and the picking time is the same. This means route optimization can only cut walking time; if the picking bottleneck comes from the pick action itself (unboxing, scanning, labeling), change the workstation layout or the packaging instead.
